dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: Er... Does "the aquabus repairman might've been put in a bad mood by my many questions" count?

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: I'm kidding! The repairman was great. He told me that there's a place nearby that produces Condessence Crystals and Magical Crystal Ore, which I can use to make models.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: That said, I don't think I'd be any good at excavation by hand — might be better to just buy the ore pre-processed. But if you have need of them, you can check the place out.
